title: Time & durations
summary: Clock times, opening hours, how long things take

sentences.en: The shop opens at nine and closes at eight.
sentences.es: La tienda abre a las nueve y cierra a las ocho.
sentences.pt: A loja abre às nove e fecha às oito.

sentences.en: I'll be here for a week.
sentences.es: Voy a estar aquí una semana.

sentences.en: I've been waiting for an hour.
sentences.pt: Estou à espera há uma hora.

sentences.es: Nos vemos dentro de dos días.

passages.text: El museo abre de martes a domingo, de diez a seis, pero la última entrada es a las cinco. La visita completa dura más o menos hora y media, así que yo vendría como muy tarde a las cuatro.
passages.en: The museum is open Tuesday to Sunday, ten to six, but last entry is at five. The full visit takes about an hour and a half, so I'd come at four at the latest.
passages.question: What is the advice?
passages.answer: Arrive by four, because the full visit takes about an hour and a half.
wrong: Come on Monday, when it is quiet.
Arrive at five for last entry, because the visit is quick.
It opens at six, so come in the evening.
